objective: Remove the auto-injected BUKLOD academic Quiz card from the public Home announcements area without placing it in Drawer; preserve academic Classroom entry and all announcements/bulletins.
productionBaselineEvidence: 2026-11-12 GitHub main 6e18a3101e8d0f18066e46dd1abdb02b190baa98: Home hub renders BuklodHomeMergedUpdates, whose public_home announcement board automatically injected BuklodQuizStudentEntry for PUBLIC scope. Screenshot confirms visible card below announcement. No Android/Web/OTA runtime verification or production release performed.
chosenApproach: Remove only the Quiz card injection from the shared announcement board, retaining announcement rendering, admin edits and bulletin loader; rename mobile and desktop Home section labels. Preserve Classroom Quiz entry and no new Drawer routes.
selectionRationale: A single public_home conditional in BuklodSystemAnnouncementBoard owns the card; removing it at its source prevents the card in loading, empty and published states, including both Home entry routes, with no changes to academic quizzes or backend records.
alternativeApproaches: Move the card to Drawer: explicitly rejected by owner.
Hide using CSS or an overlay: rejected because the Quiz component would still mount and waste resources.
Delete BUKLOD Quiz feature: rejected because the request targets the Home card and Classroom exams must remain functional.
acceptanceChecks: Public Home announcement board no longer renders BUKLOD Quiz in loading, empty or published states.
Mobile and desktop Home update labels omit Quiz while announcements and bulletins still render.
Academic Quiz launcher stays under Classroom and exam records are untouched.
Drawer receives no Quiz card or route.
DEV tests and release gate pass before RC or OTA.
preserveBehaviors: Public Home announcements, admin edit control, scope bulletins and encouragement stay intact.
Classroom student Quiz SSO entry, exam access and historical academic records are unchanged.
BUKLOD ads, Wall, Connect, privacy, rewards and all unrelated screens are unmodified.
Consolidated DEV to RC to production OTA release gates stay enforced.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Remove only public-home academic Quiz launcher while keeping announcement/bulletin mount behavior, main Home focus-gating, and Classroom Quiz access stable.
preservedBehaviors: Home announcements and bulletins render in both desktop and mobile variants; Classroom Quiz SSO entry and admin board editing remain available.
